     3	/-!
     4	# Range projections in Pauli soundness
     5	
     6	Inserting an orthogonal projection into a measurement comparison costs at most
     7	twice the squared distance to a vector fixed by that projection. Summing over
     8	the measurement outcomes introduces no factor depending on their number.
     9	
    10	## References
    11	
    12	These are formalization-only auxiliary estimates for the final proof of
    13	blueprint `thm:pauli`. The range projection is omitted at
    14	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1864-1875`;
    15	the corrected calculation is given in `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_extraction-transfer.tex`.
    16	They do not construct the extraction data or prove Pauli soundness.
    17	-/
    18	
    19	open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
    20	
    21	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    22	
    23	open MIPStarRE.Quantum
    24	open DistanceCalculus MagicSquareRigidity
    25	
    26	/-- The identity conjugated by an isometry is its orthogonal range projection. -/
    27	private theorem conjIsometry_one_isProj {ι κ : Type}
    28	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    29	    (phi : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κ) :
    30	    IsProj (conjIsometry phi 1) := by
    31	  constructor
    32	  · change conjIsometry phi 1 * conjIsometry phi 1 = conjIsometry phi 1
    33	    rw [conjIsometry_mul, Matrix.one_mul]
    34	  · change star (conjIsometry phi 1) = conjIsometry phi 1
    35	    simp [conjIsometry_eq, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul]
    36	
    37	/-- Intertwining identifies isometry conjugation with insertion of its range projection. -/
    38	private theorem mul_conjIsometry_one_eq {ι κ : Type}
    39	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    40	    (phi : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κ) (M : Op ι) (N : Op κ)
    41	    (hintertwine : N * isometryMatrix phi = isometryMatrix phi * M) :
    42	    N * conjIsometry phi 1 = conjIsometry phi M := by
    43	  rw [conjIsometry_eq, Matrix.mul_one, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hintertwine]
    44	  rfl
    45	
    46	/-- Inserting a projection that fixes `theta` into a complete POVM costs at most
    47	twice the squared distance from the comparison state to `theta`, in addition
    48	to twice the original operator-family distance. This is blueprint
    49	`thm:pauli-range-projection-support`, the analytic range-projection estimate
    50	supporting `thm:pauli`. It holds for every complete POVM. -/
    51	theorem sum_norm_mul_projection_sub_sq_le {α ι : Type*}
    52	    [Fintype α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    53	    (N : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α ι) (T : α → Op ι)
    54	    (Q : Op ι) (hQ : IsProj Q) (theta delta : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι)
    55	    (htheta : applyOperatorToState Q theta = theta) :
    56	    ∑ a : α, ‖applyOperatorToState (N.effect a * Q - T a) delta‖ ^ 2 ≤
    57	      2 * (∑ a : α, ‖applyOperatorToState (N.effect a - T a) delta‖ ^ 2) +
    58	        2 * ‖delta - theta‖ ^ 2 := by
    59	  have hvanish : applyOperatorToState (1 - Q) theta = 0 := by
    60	    have hfix : Matrix.toEuclideanLin Q theta = theta := htheta
    61	    simp [applyOperatorToState, hfix]
    62	  have hcomplement :
    63	      ‖applyOperatorToState (1 - Q) delta‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖delta - theta‖ ^ 2 := by
    64	    have hnorm := norm_applyOperatorToState_le
    65	      (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj hQ.one_sub) (delta - theta)
    66	    rw [applyOperatorToState_sub, hvanish, sub_zero] at hnorm
    67	    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hnorm 2
    68	  have hsum := sum_norm_mul_apply_le N.effect (1 - Q) delta
    69	    (MIPStarRE.QPBT.measurement_sum_adjoint_mul_le_one N)
    70	  calc
    71	    ∑ a : α, ‖applyOperatorToState (N.effect a * Q - T a) delta‖ ^ 2 ≤
    72	        ∑ a : α, (2 * ‖applyOperatorToState (N.effect a - T a) delta‖ ^ 2 +
    73	          2 * ‖applyOperatorToState (N.effect a * (1 - Q)) delta‖ ^ 2) := by
    74	      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    75	      intro a _
    76	      have hsplit : N.effect a * Q - T a =
    77	          (N.effect a - T a) - N.effect a * (1 - Q) := by
    78	        rw [mul_sub, mul_one]
    79	        abel
    80	      have hsplit_action : applyOperatorToState (N.effect a * Q - T a) delta =
    81	          applyOperatorToState (N.effect a - T a) delta -
    82	            applyOperatorToState (N.effect a * (1 - Q)) delta := by
    83	        rw [hsplit]
    84	        simp only [applyOperatorToState, map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply]
    85	      rw [hsplit_action]
    86	      have hpar := parallelogram_law_with_norm ℂ
    87	        (applyOperatorToState (N.effect a - T a) delta)
    88	        (applyOperatorToState (N.effect a * (1 - Q)) delta)
    89	      exact (le_add_of_nonneg_left (sq_nonneg
    90	        ‖applyOperatorToState (N.effect a - T a) delta +
    91	          applyOperatorToState (N.effect a * (1 - Q)) delta‖)).trans_eq
    92	        (hpar.trans (mul_add 2 _ _))
    93	    _ = 2 * (∑ a : α, ‖applyOperatorToState (N.effect a - T a) delta‖ ^ 2) +
    94	        2 * (∑ a : α, ‖applyOperatorToState (N.effect a * (1 - Q)) delta‖ ^ 2) := by
    95	      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
    96	    _ ≤ _ := add_le_add le_rfl (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    97	      (hsum.trans hcomplement) (by norm_num))
    98	
    99	/-- The range-projection estimate for an isometry intertwining an operator
   100	family with a complete POVM, as in blueprint `thm:pauli-isometry-transfer-support`.
   101	The intertwining identity is an exact operator
   102	identity, as obtained by adjoining a fixed ancilla and then conjugating by a
   103	unitary in the final proof of blueprint `thm:pauli`. No state or operator
   104	closeness is assumed: both errors appear explicitly on the right-hand side. -/
   105	theorem sum_norm_conjIsometry_sub_sq_le {α ι κ : Type}
   106	    [Fintype α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
   107	    (phi : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κ)
   108	    (M : α → Op ι) (N : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α κ) (T : α → Op κ)
   109	    (hintertwine : ∀ a : α,
   110	      N.effect a * isometryMatrix phi = isometryMatrix phi * M a)
   111	    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (delta : EuclideanSpace ℂ κ) :
   112	    ∑ a : α, ‖applyOperatorToState (conjIsometry phi (M a) - T a) delta‖ ^ 2 ≤
   113	      2 * (∑ a : α, ‖applyOperatorToState (N.effect a - T a) delta‖ ^ 2) +
   114	        2 * ‖delta - phi psi‖ ^ 2 := by
   115	  let Q : Op κ := conjIsometry phi 1
   116	  have hQ : IsProj Q := conjIsometry_one_isProj phi
   117	  have hmatrix : Matrix.toEuclideanLin (isometryMatrix phi) = phi.toLinearMap :=
   118	    Matrix.toEuclideanLin.apply_symm_apply phi.toLinearMap
   119	  have hfix : applyOperatorToState Q (phi psi) = phi psi := by
   120	    change Matrix.toEuclideanLin (conjIsometry phi 1) (phi.toLinearMap psi) =
   121	      phi.toLinearMap psi
   122	    rw [conjIsometry_eq, Matrix.mul_one, ← hmatrix, ← toEuclideanLin_mul_apply,
   123	      Matrix.mul_assoc, isometryMatrix_conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
   124	  have hcompression (a : α) : N.effect a * Q = conjIsometry phi (M a) :=
   125	    mul_conjIsometry_one_eq phi (M a) (N.effect a) (hintertwine a)
   126	  simpa only [hcompression] using
   127	    sum_norm_mul_projection_sub_sq_le N T Q hQ (phi psi) delta hfix
   128	
   129	/-- Alice's isometry transfer on a bipartite comparison state. The state error
   130	uses both local isometries, while each effect is conjugated only by Alice's
   131	isometry, as required by blueprint `thm:pauli`. The exact local intertwining
   132	identity is the one obtained from the ancilla extension and swap unitary.
   133	This is blueprint `thm:pauli-isometry-transfer-alice-support`. -/
   134	theorem sum_norm_leftTensor_conjIsometry_sub_sq_le {α ιA ιB κA κB : Type}
   135	    [Fintype α] [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
   136	    [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA] [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB]
   137	    (phiA : EuclideanSpace ℂ ιA →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
   138	    (phiB : EuclideanSpace ℂ ιB →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
   139	    (M : α → Op ιA) (N : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α κA)
   140	    (T : α → Op (κA × κB))
   141	    (hintertwine : ∀ a : α,
   142	      N.effect a * isometryMatrix phiA = isometryMatrix phiA * M a)
   143	    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (delta : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB)) :
   144	    ∑ a : α, ‖applyOperatorToState
   145	        (heteroKron (conjIsometry phiA (M a)) 1 - T a) delta‖ ^ 2 ≤
   146	      2 * (∑ a : α, ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (N.effect a) 1 - T a) delta‖ ^ 2) +
   147	        2 * ‖delta - isometryTensor phiA phiB psi‖ ^ 2 := by
   148	  let Q : Op (κA × κB) := heteroKron (conjIsometry phiA 1) 1
   149	  have hQ : IsProj Q := by
   150	    constructor
   151	    · change Q * Q = Q
   152	      simp only [Q, heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul,
   153	        (conjIsometry_one_isProj phiA).isIdempotentElem.eq]
   154	    · change star Q = Q
   155	      simp only [Q, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker,
   156	        Matrix.conjTranspose_kronecker, Matrix.conjTranspose_one,
   157	        (conjIsometry_one_isProj phiA).isSelfAdjoint.isHermitian.eq]
   158	  have hfix : applyOperatorToState Q (isometryTensor phiA phiB psi) =
   159	      isometryTensor phiA phiB psi := by
   160	    dsimp only [Q]
   161	    rw [applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_conjIsometry, heteroKron_one_one,
   162	      applyOperatorToState_one]
   163	  have hcompression (a : α) : (leftPlacedMeasurement N).effect a * Q =
   164	      heteroKron (conjIsometry phiA (M a)) 1 := by
   165	    change heteroKron (N.effect a) 1 * heteroKron (conjIsometry phiA 1) 1 = _
   166	    rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul,
   167	      mul_conjIsometry_one_eq phiA (M a) (N.effect a) (hintertwine a)]
   168	  have hbound := sum_norm_mul_projection_sub_sq_le (leftPlacedMeasurement N) T Q hQ
   169	    (isometryTensor phiA phiB psi) delta hfix
   170	  simp only [hcompression] at hbound
   171	  simpa only [leftPlacedMeasurement, MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne] using hbound
   172	
   173	/-- Bob's isometry transfer on a bipartite comparison state, with the same
   174	state error and constants independent of the answer count as Alice's transfer.
   175	This is blueprint `thm:pauli-isometry-transfer-bob-support`, the second
   176	operator comparison needed in the proof of `thm:pauli`. -/
   177	theorem sum_norm_rightTensor_conjIsometry_sub_sq_le {α ιA ιB κA κB : Type}
   178	    [Fintype α] [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
   179	    [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA] [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB]
   180	    (phiA : EuclideanSpace ℂ ιA →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
   181	    (phiB : EuclideanSpace ℂ ιB →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
   182	    (M : α → Op ιB) (N : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α κB)
   183	    (T : α → Op (κA × κB))
   184	    (hintertwine : ∀ a : α,
   185	      N.effect a * isometryMatrix phiB = isometryMatrix phiB * M a)
   186	    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (delta : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB)) :
   187	    ∑ a : α, ‖applyOperatorToState
   188	        (heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry phiB (M a)) - T a) delta‖ ^ 2 ≤
   189	      2 * (∑ a : α, ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (N.effect a) - T a) delta‖ ^ 2) +
   190	        2 * ‖delta - isometryTensor phiA phiB psi‖ ^ 2 := by
   191	  let Q : Op (κA × κB) := heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry phiB 1)
   192	  have hQ : IsProj Q := by
   193	    constructor
   194	    · change Q * Q = Q
   195	      simp only [Q, heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul,
   196	        (conjIsometry_one_isProj phiB).isIdempotentElem.eq]
   197	    · change star Q = Q
   198	      simp only [Q, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker,
   199	        Matrix.conjTranspose_kronecker, Matrix.conjTranspose_one,
   200	        (conjIsometry_one_isProj phiB).isSelfAdjoint.isHermitian.eq]
   201	  have hfix : applyOperatorToState Q (isometryTensor phiA phiB psi) =
   202	      isometryTensor phiA phiB psi := by
   203	    dsimp only [Q]
   204	    rw [applyOperatorToState_rightTensor_conjIsometry, heteroKron_one_one,
   205	      applyOperatorToState_one]
   206	  have hcompression (a : α) : (rightPlacedMeasurement N).effect a * Q =
   207	      heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry phiB (M a)) := by
   208	    change heteroKron 1 (N.effect a) * heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry phiB 1) = _
   209	    rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul,
   210	      mul_conjIsometry_one_eq phiB (M a) (N.effect a) (hintertwine a)]
   211	  have hbound := sum_norm_mul_projection_sub_sq_le (rightPlacedMeasurement N) T Q hQ
   212	    (isometryTensor phiA phiB psi) delta hfix
   213	  simp only [hcompression] at hbound
   214	  simpa only [rightPlacedMeasurement, MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne] using hbound
   215	
   216	end MIPStarRE.QPBT

     1	import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Test.Soundness.RangeProjection
     2	
     3	/-!
     4	# Ancilla isometries for Pauli soundness
     5	
     6	Adjoining a unit vector and applying a unitary gives the local isometry in the
     7	final soundness argument. The exact intertwining identity below supplies the
     8	algebraic hypothesis of the range-projection estimates. These results are
     9	recorded in blueprint `thm:pauli-ancilla-intertwining-support`.
    10	
    11	## References
    12	
    13	Formalization support for blueprint `thm:pauli`, specifically the isometry at
    14	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1864-1875`.
    15	The registers are ordered as `AA'A''`, with the first two factors grouped.
    16	These constructions do not assume or construct a global polynomial measurement.
    17	-/
    18	
    19	open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
    20	
    21	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    22	
    23	open MIPStarRE.Quantum MagicSquareRigidity
    24	
    25	noncomputable section
    26	
    27	variable {ι κ ν : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    28	  [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] [Fintype ν] [DecidableEq ν]
    29	
    30	/-- Adjoin a unit ancilla on the last two registers, in the extraction order
    31	`(AA')A''`. The norm condition is precisely the normalization of that ancilla. -/
    32	def ancillaBlockIsometry (eta : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κ × ν)) (heta : ‖eta‖ = 1) :
    33	    EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ ((ι × κ) × ν) where
    34	  toFun psi := reindexState (Equiv.prodAssoc ι κ ν).symm (vecTensor psi eta)
    35	  map_add' psi chi := by
    36	    ext p
    37	    simp [reindexState, vecTensor, add_mul]
    38	  map_smul' c psi := by
    39	    ext p
    40	    simp [reindexState, vecTensor, mul_assoc]
    41	  norm_map' psi := by
    42	    change ‖reindexState (Equiv.prodAssoc ι κ ν).symm (vecTensor psi eta)‖ = ‖psi‖
    43	    rw [reindexState_norm_eq, vecTensor_norm_eq, heta, mul_one]
    44	
    45	/-- The columns of the ancilla isometry are the original basis vectors
    46	tensored with the fixed ancilla. -/
    47	theorem ancillaBlockIsometry_matrix_apply
    48	    (eta : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κ × ν)) (heta : ‖eta‖ = 1)
    49	    (p : (ι × κ) × ν) (i : ι) :
    50	    isometryMatrix (ancillaBlockIsometry (ι := ι) eta heta) p i =
    51	      if p.1.1 = i then eta (p.1.2, p.2) else 0 := by
    52	  rw [isometryMatrix_apply]
    53	  simp [ancillaBlockIsometry, reindexState, vecTensor, eq_comm]
    54	
    55	/-- Extending an operator by identities commutes with adjoining a fixed ancilla.
    56	This exact identity is independent of any success or consistency estimate. -/
    57	theorem ancillaBlockIsometry_intertwines
    58	    (eta : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κ × ν)) (heta : ‖eta‖ = 1) (M : Op ι) :
    59	    heteroKron (heteroKron M (1 : Op κ)) (1 : Op ν) *
    60	        isometryMatrix (ancillaBlockIsometry (ι := ι) eta heta) =
    61	      isometryMatrix (ancillaBlockIsometry (ι := ι) eta heta) * M := by
    62	  ext p i
    63	  simp [Matrix.mul_apply, ancillaBlockIsometry_matrix_apply, heteroKron,
    64	    Matrix.kronecker, Matrix.one_apply, Fintype.sum_prod_type, mul_comm]
    65	
    66	/-- Apply a matrix isometry after adjoining the unit ancilla. In the source
    67	proof the matrix is the swap unitary and the ancilla is the local EPR state. -/
    68	def unitaryAncillaIsometry (eta : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κ × ν)) (heta : ‖eta‖ = 1)
    69	    (U : Op ((ι × κ) × ν)) (hU : Uᴴ * U = 1) :
    70	    EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ ((ι × κ) × ν) where
    71	  toLinearMap := (Matrix.toEuclideanLin U).comp
    72	    (ancillaBlockIsometry eta heta).toLinearMap
    73	  norm_map' psi := by
    74	    change ‖Matrix.toEuclideanLin U (ancillaBlockIsometry eta heta psi)‖ = ‖psi‖
    75	    rw [norm_toEuclideanLin_of_conjTranspose_mul_eq_one hU, LinearIsometry.norm_map]
    76	
    77	/-- The matrix of the extraction isometry is the unitary times the ancilla
    78	embedding, with no range projection omitted. -/
    79	theorem unitaryAncillaIsometry_matrix
    80	    (eta : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κ × ν)) (heta : ‖eta‖ = 1)
    81	    (U : Op ((ι × κ) × ν)) (hU : Uᴴ * U = 1) :
    82	    isometryMatrix (unitaryAncillaIsometry eta heta U hU) =
    83	      U * isometryMatrix (ancillaBlockIsometry (ι := ι) eta heta) := by
    84	  apply Matrix.toEuclideanLin.injective
    85	  apply LinearMap.ext
    86	  intro psi
    87	  rw [toEuclideanLin_mul_apply]
    88	  simp only [isometryMatrix, Matrix.toEuclideanLin.apply_symm_apply]
    89	  rfl
    90	
    91	/-- The unitary conjugate of an extended operator intertwines with the
    92	extraction isometry. This proves the exact hypothesis needed by
    93	`sum_norm_leftTensor_conjIsometry_sub_sq_le` and its Bob-side counterpart
    94	for the local isometries used in the final proof of `thm:pauli`. -/
    95	theorem unitaryAncillaIsometry_intertwines
    96	    (eta : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κ × ν)) (heta : ‖eta‖ = 1)
    97	    (U : Op ((ι × κ) × ν)) (hU : Uᴴ * U = 1) (M : Op ι) :
    98	    (U * heteroKron (heteroKron M (1 : Op κ)) (1 : Op ν) * Uᴴ) *
    99	        isometryMatrix (unitaryAncillaIsometry eta heta U hU) =
   100	      isometryMatrix (unitaryAncillaIsometry eta heta U hU) * M := by
   101	  rw [unitaryAncillaIsometry_matrix]
   102	  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
   103	  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Uᴴ U, hU, Matrix.one_mul,
   104	    ancillaBlockIsometry_intertwines]
   105	
   106	end
   107	
   108	end MIPStarRE.QPBT

     5	/-!
     6	# Total Pauli measurements under the extraction swaps
     7	
     8	The evaluated overlap on the swapped state is the original evaluated-Pauli
     9	consistency overlap. Both player orientations retain their six-register
    10	placements. These identities instantiate the ideal-state Pauli comparison.
    11	
    12	## References
    13	
    14	Blueprint `lem:qld-unitary`; paper
    15	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1785-1858`,
    16	especially `eq:qld-unitary-6` and `eq:qld-unitary-9`.
    17	-/
    18	
    19	open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder Classical
    20	
    21	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    22	
    23	open MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus
    24	open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
    25	
    26	noncomputable section
    27	
    28	/-- Simultaneous unitary conjugation preserves the quadratic form of a product. -/
    29	theorem stateQForm_conjBy_mul_apply {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    30	    (U A B : Op I) (hU : Uᴴ * U = 1) (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ I) :
    31	    stateQForm (applyOperatorToState U psi) (conjBy U A * conjBy U B) =
    32	      stateQForm psi (A * B) := by
    33	  rw [← stateQForm_conjTranspose_mul_mul]
    34	  congr 1
    35	  simp only [conjBy]
    36	  calc
    37	    _ = (Uᴴ * U) * A * (Uᴴ * U) * B * (Uᴴ * U) := by noncomm_ring
    38	    _ = A * B := by rw [hU]; simp
    39	
    40	namespace ProjectiveSetting
    41	
    42	variable {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ}
    43	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon)
    44	
    45	/-- The total Pauli POVM extended to the full local extraction block and
    46	conjugated by the concrete swap. This is the measurement in `eq:qld-unitary-7`. -/
    47	def swappedPauliMeas (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (side : PlayerSide)
    48	    (W : PauliKind) : Measurement (PauliRegister P) (ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace side)) :=
    49	  Measurement.ofSumEqOne
    50	    (fun h => conjBy (swapUnitary w side) (S.onPlayer side ((S.pauliMeas side W).effect h)))
    51	    (fun h => by
    52	      apply star_right_conjugate_nonneg
    53	      exact kronecker_nonneg
    54	        (kronecker_nonneg ((S.pauliMeas side W).pos h) Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg)
    55	        Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg)
    56	    (by
    57	      simp only [conjBy, onPlayer, ← Finset.sum_mul, ← Matrix.mul_sum,
    58	        ← heteroKron_finset_sum_left, (S.pauliMeas side W).sum_eq_one,
    59	        heteroKron_one_one, Matrix.mul_one, swapUnitary_mul_conjTranspose])
    60	
    61	/-- Coarse-graining commutes with extending and conjugating the Pauli POVM. -/
    62	theorem swappedPauliMeas_eval_effect (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG)
    63	    (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
    64	    (a : PauliScalar P) :
    65	    ((S.swappedPauliMeas w side W).postprocess
    66	      (fun h => evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u)).effect a =
    67	      conjBy (swapUnitary w side) (S.onPlayer side ((S.pauliEvalMeas side W u).effect a)) := by
    68	  simp only [swappedPauliMeas, Measurement.postprocess_effect, Measurement.ofSumEqOne,
    69	    pauliEvalMeas, conjBy, onPlayer, ← Finset.sum_mul, ← Matrix.mul_sum,
    70	    ← heteroKron_finset_sum_left]
    71	  rfl
    72	
    73	/-- Original-player placement agrees with extension to the whole local block. -/
    74	theorem placeSide_onPlayer (side : PlayerSide) (A : Op (S.LocalSpace side)) :
    75	    S.placeSide side (S.onPlayer side A) = S.placePlayer side A := by
    76	  cases side
    77	  · exact S.placeSide_alice_tensor_one _
    78	  · exact S.placeSide_bob_tensor_one _
    79	
    80	/-- The canonical last-register effect has the same block and crossed placements. -/
    81	theorem placeSide_extracted (side : PlayerSide) (T : Op (PauliRegister P)) :
    82	    S.placeSide side (heteroKron (1 : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side)) T) =
    83	      S.placeExtractedRegister side T := by
    84	  cases side
    85	  · ext row col
    86	    change
    87	      ((if (row.1.1, row.1.2.1) = (col.1.1, col.1.2.1) then (1 : ℂ) else 0) *
    88	        T row.1.2.2 col.1.2.2) *
    89	        (if ((row.2.1, row.2.2.1), row.2.2.2) =
    90	          ((col.2.1, col.2.2.1), col.2.2.2) then 1 else 0) =
    91	      (if row.1.1 = col.1.1 then 1 else 0) *
    92	        (if row.1.2.1 = col.1.2.1 then 1 else 0) *
    93	        ((if row.2.1 = col.2.1 then 1 else 0) * T row.1.2.2 col.1.2.2) *
    94	        (if row.2.2.1 = col.2.2.1 then 1 else 0) *
    95	        (if row.2.2.2 = col.2.2.2 then 1 else 0)
    96	    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, ite_and, ite_mul, mul_ite, one_mul, mul_one,
    97	      zero_mul, mul_zero]
    98	    split_ifs <;> rfl
    99	  · ext row col
   100	    change
   101	      (if ((row.1.1, row.1.2.1), row.1.2.2) =
   102	        ((col.1.1, col.1.2.1), col.1.2.2) then (1 : ℂ) else 0) *
   103	        ((if (row.2.1, row.2.2.1) = (col.2.1, col.2.2.1) then 1 else 0) *
   104	          T row.2.2.2 col.2.2.2) =
   105	      ((if row.1.1 = col.1.1 then 1 else 0) * T row.2.2.2 col.2.2.2) *
   106	        (if row.1.2.1 = col.1.2.1 then 1 else 0) *
   107	        (if row.1.2.2 = col.1.2.2 then 1 else 0) *
   108	        (if row.2.1 = col.2.1 then 1 else 0) *
   109	        (if row.2.2.1 = col.2.2.1 then 1 else 0)
   110	    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, ite_and, ite_mul, mul_ite, one_mul, mul_one,
   111	      zero_mul, mul_zero]
   112	    split_ifs <;> rfl

   114	/-- Block placement preserves conjugation. -/
   115	theorem placeSide_conjBy (side : PlayerSide)
   116	    (U A : Op (ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace side))) :
   117	    S.placeSide side (conjBy U A) = conjBy (S.placeSide side U) (S.placeSide side A) := by
   118	  cases side <;>
   119	    simp only [placeSide, conjBy, ← reindexOp_conjTranspose,
   120	      ← WinImplications.reindexOp_mul, MagicSquareRigidity.heteroKron_conjTranspose,
   121	      heteroKron_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_one, Matrix.mul_one] <;> rfl
   122	
   123	/-- Conjugated total-Pauli effects in block coordinates give exactly the
   124	six-register operators required by the extraction witness. -/
   125	theorem placeSide_swappedPauliMeas (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG)
   126	    (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) (h : PauliRegister P) :
   127	    S.placeSide side ((S.swappedPauliMeas w side W).effect h) =
   128	      conjBy (S.placeSide side (swapUnitary w side))
   129	        (S.placePlayer side ((S.pauliMeas side W).effect h)) := by
   130	  exact (S.placeSide_conjBy side _ _).trans
   131	    (congrArg (conjBy (S.placeSide side (swapUnitary w side))) (S.placeSide_onPlayer side _))
   132	
   133	/-- The evaluated canonical block measurement is the swap-conjugated
   134	pulled-apart measurement, by `eq:qld-unitary-6`. -/
   135	theorem canonical_eval_eq_conj_tildeM (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG)
   136	    (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
   137	    (a : PauliScalar P) :
   138	    ((rightPlacedMeasurement (ιA := S.ExpandedLocalSpace side)
   139	      (pauliRegisterMeas (params := P) W)).postprocess
   140	      (fun h => evalPoly (encodingPoly h) u)).effect a =
   141	      conjBy (swapUnitary w side) (tildeM w side W (indicatorVec u) a) := by
   142	  rw [swapUnitary_conj_tildeM]
   143	  simp only [Measurement.postprocess_effect, rightPlacedMeasurement,
   144	    Measurement.ofSumEqOne, pauliRegisterMeas, bracketOp, ← heteroKron_finset_sum_right]
   145	  rfl
   146	
   147	/-- Multiplying the two block placements is their tensor product in block coordinates. -/
   148	theorem reindexOp_heteroKron_eq_placeSides
   149	    (A : Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιA))
   150	    (B : Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιB)) :
   151	    reindexOp (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
   152	      (heteroKron A B) = S.placeSide .alice A * S.placeSide .bob B := by
   153	  simp only [placeSide, ← WinImplications.reindexOp_mul, heteroKron_mul,

     5

    19	`lem:pauli-binary`, paper

    22	noncomputable def conjIsometry {ι ι' : Type*}
    23	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι']
    24	    (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ ι')
    25	    (M : Op ι) : Op ι' :=

    30	`def:strategy-distance`, paper `06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:273-285`. -/
    31	noncomputable def reindexState {ι ι' : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    32	    [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι'] (e : ι ≃ ι')
    33	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι' :=

    41	    {ιA ιB κA κB : Type*}

    43	    [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA] [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB]
    44	    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ ιA →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)

    98	  have hlocal : ∑ h : PauliRegister P, (pauliProj W h)ᴴ * pauliProj W h = 1 := by
    99	    simp only [fun h => (posSemidef_pauliProj W h).isHermitian.eq,
   100	      pauliProj_mul_pauliProj, ite_true]
   101	    exact sum_pauliProj_eq_one W
   102	  have htensor {R : Type} [Fintype R] [DecidableEq R] :
   103	      ∑ h : PauliRegister P, (heteroKron (1 : Op R) (pauliProj W h))ᴴ *
   104	        heteroKron (1 : Op R) (pauliProj W h) = 1 := by
   105	    simp only [MagicSquareRigidity.heteroKron_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_one,
   106	      heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul, ← heteroKron_finset_sum_right, hlocal,
   107	      heteroKron_one_one]
   108	  cases side <;> apply sum_place_sq_eq_one <;> exact htensor
   109	
   110	/-- The entire conjugated total-Pauli family is square-complete; conjugation
   111	does not introduce a factor equal to the number of answers. -/
   112	theorem sum_conj_pauli_sq (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG)
   113	    (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) :
   114	    ∑ h : PauliRegister P,
   115	      (conjBy (S.placeSide side (swapUnitary w side))
   116	        (S.placePlayer side ((S.pauliMeas side W).effect h)))ᴴ *
   117	      conjBy (S.placeSide side (swapUnitary w side))
   118	        (S.placePlayer side ((S.pauliMeas side W).effect h)) = 1 := by
   119	  classical
   120	  let U := S.placeSide side (swapUnitary w side)
   121	  have hU : Uᴴ * U = 1 := S.placeSide_swap_left_unitary w side
   122	  have hU' : U * Uᴴ = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hU
   123	  have hterm (A : Op (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)) :
   124	      (conjBy U A)ᴴ * conjBy U A = U * (Aᴴ * A) * Uᴴ := by
   125	    simp only [conjBy, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
   126	    calc
   127	      _ = U * (Aᴴ * (Uᴴ * U) * A) * Uᴴ := by noncomm_ring
   128	      _ = _ := by rw [hU, Matrix.mul_one]
   129	  change (∑ h, (conjBy U _)ᴴ * conjBy U _) = 1
   130	  simp_rw [hterm]
   131	  rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Matrix.mul_sum, S.sum_placePlayer_pauli_sq,
   132	    Matrix.mul_one, hU']
   133	
   134	/-- On any normalized ideal state the extraction measurement error is at
   135	most four, uniformly in the local dimensions and number of answers. -/
   136	theorem extraction_pauli_dist_le_four (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG)
   137	    (aux : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ExtractionAuxRegisters P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB))
   138	    (haux : ‖aux‖ = 1) (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) :
   139	    opFamilyDistSq (MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution Unit)
   140	      (fun (_ : Unit) (h : PauliRegister P) =>
   141	        conjBy (S.placeSide side (swapUnitary w side))
   142	          (S.placePlayer side ((S.pauliMeas side W).effect h)))
   143	      (fun (_ : Unit) (h : PauliRegister P) =>
   144	        S.placeExtractedRegister side (pauliProj W h)) (S.idealExpState aux) ≤ 4 := by
   145	  apply opFamilyDistSq_uniform_le_four
   146	  · rw [S.idealExpState_norm, haux]
   147	  · intro _
   148	    exact (S.sum_conj_pauli_sq w side W).le
   149	  · intro _
   150	    exact (S.sum_placeExtractedRegister_pauli_sq side W).le
   151	
   152	end ProjectiveSetting
   153	
   154	end
   155	
   156	end MIPStarRE.QPBT

+++ b/MIPStarRE/QPBT/Test/Soundness/OperatorTransfer.lean
@@ -0,0 +1,282 @@
+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Test.Soundness.StateTransfer
+
+/-!
+# Operator transfer from supplied extraction data
+
+The complete swap-conjugated measurements intertwine with the local ancilla
+isometries. The range-projection estimates then transfer both Pauli families
+to the ideal state, with squared error at most four times the extraction error.
+
+## References
+
+Formalization support for the final argument at
+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1864-1875`.
+This conditional construction uses supplied extraction data in a projective
+setting; it does not prove blueprint `thm:pauli`. The omitted range projection
+is documented in `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_extraction-transfer.tex` (issue #529).
+-/
+
+open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
+
+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
+
+open MIPStarRE.Quantum MagicSquareRigidity DistanceCalculus
+
+noncomputable section
+
+variable {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG delta : ℝ}
+  {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon} {w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG}
+
+private theorem extracted_alice_eq (W : PauliKind) (h : PauliRegister P) :
+    S.placeExtractedRegister .alice (pauliProj W h) =
+      reindexOp (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
+        (pauliProjOnA'' P (ιA' := S.toStrategy.ιA × PauliRegister P)
+          (ιB' := S.toStrategy.ιB × PauliRegister P) W h) := by
+  ext i j
+  change (1 : Op S.toStrategy.ιA) i.1.1 j.1.1 *
+    (1 : Op (PauliRegister P)) i.1.2.1 j.1.2.1 *
+    ((1 : Op S.toStrategy.ιB) i.2.1 j.2.1 * pauliProj W h i.1.2.2 j.1.2.2) *
+    (1 : Op (PauliRegister P)) i.2.2.1 j.2.2.1 *
+    (1 : Op (PauliRegister P)) i.2.2.2 j.2.2.2 = _
+  simp [reindexOp, sixRegExtractionEquiv, pauliProjOnA'',
+    Matrix.one_apply, Prod.ext_iff, ite_and, mul_ite, ite_mul]
+  split_ifs <;> simp_all
+
+private theorem extracted_bob_eq (W : PauliKind) (h : PauliRegister P) :
+    S.placeExtractedRegister .bob (pauliProj W h) =
+      reindexOp (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
+        (pauliProjOnB'' P (ιA' := S.toStrategy.ιA × PauliRegister P)
+          (ιB' := S.toStrategy.ιB × PauliRegister P) W h) := by
+  ext i j
+  change ((1 : Op S.toStrategy.ιA) i.1.1 j.1.1 * pauliProj W h i.2.2.2 j.2.2.2) *
+    (1 : Op (PauliRegister P)) i.1.2.1 j.1.2.1 *
+    (1 : Op (PauliRegister P)) i.1.2.2 j.1.2.2 *
+    (1 : Op S.toStrategy.ιB) i.2.1 j.2.1 *
+    (1 : Op (PauliRegister P)) i.2.2.1 j.2.2.1 = _
+  simp [reindexOp, sixRegExtractionEquiv, pauliProjOnB'',
+    Matrix.one_apply, Prod.ext_iff, ite_and, mul_ite, ite_mul]
+  split_ifs <;> simp_all
+
+private theorem conjugated_alice_eq (_v : ExtractionWitness S w delta)
+    (W : PauliKind) (h : PauliRegister P) :
+    conjBy (S.placeSide .alice (swapUnitary w .alice))
+        (S.placePlayer .alice ((S.pauliMeas .alice W).effect h)) =
+      reindexOp (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
+        (heteroKron ((S.swappedPauliMeas w .alice W).effect h) 1) := by
+  exact (S.placeSide_swappedPauliMeas w .alice W h).symm
+
+private theorem conjugated_bob_eq (_v : ExtractionWitness S w delta)
+    (W : PauliKind) (h : PauliRegister P) :
+    conjBy (S.placeSide .bob (swapUnitary w .bob))
+        (S.placePlayer .bob ((S.pauliMeas .bob W).effect h)) =
+      reindexOp (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
+        (heteroKron 1 ((S.swappedPauliMeas w .bob W).effect h)) := by
+  exact (S.placeSide_swappedPauliMeas w .bob W h).symm
+
+private theorem full_pauli_distance_alice (v : ExtractionWitness S w delta)
+    (W : PauliKind) :
+    ∑ h : PauliRegister P, ‖applyOperatorToState
+      (heteroKron ((S.swappedPauliMeas w .alice W).effect h) 1 -
+        pauliProjOnA'' P W h) (idealState P v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.aux)‖ ^ 2 ≤ delta := by
+  classical
+  have hc := v.pauli_close .alice W
+  rw [opFamilyDistSq_uniform_unit] at hc
+  simp_rw [conjugated_alice_eq v, extracted_alice_eq,
+    ← WinImplications.reindexOp_sub,
+    ← WinImplications.norm_applyOperatorToState_reindexState] at hc
+  rw [v.idealState_eq]
+  exact hc
+
+private theorem full_pauli_distance_bob (v : ExtractionWitness S w delta)
+    (W : PauliKind) :
+    ∑ h : PauliRegister P, ‖applyOperatorToState
+      (heteroKron 1 ((S.swappedPauliMeas w .bob W).effect h) -
+        pauliProjOnB'' P W h) (idealState P v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.aux)‖ ^ 2 ≤ delta := by
+  classical
+  have hc := v.pauli_close .bob W
+  rw [opFamilyDistSq_uniform_unit] at hc
+  simp_rw [conjugated_bob_eq v, extracted_bob_eq,
+    ← WinImplications.reindexOp_sub,
+    ← WinImplications.norm_applyOperatorToState_reindexState] at hc
+  rw [v.idealState_eq]
+  exact hc
+
+/-- Alice's isometry-conjugated Pauli family has squared distance at most
+`4 * delta` on the ideal state. Both the full-unitary comparison and the
+squared state error are read from the supplied extraction witness. -/
+theorem ExtractionWitness.pauli_distance_alice_le (v : ExtractionWitness S w delta)
+    (W : PauliKind) :
+    pauliOperatorDistanceA P S.toStrategy v.toPauliSoundnessWitness W ≤ 4 * delta := by
+  have h := sum_norm_leftTensor_conjIsometry_sub_sq_le
+    v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.φA v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.φB
+    (S.pauliMeas .alice W).effect (S.swappedPauliMeas w .alice W)
+    (pauliProjOnA'' P W)
+    (fun h => unitaryAncillaIsometry_intertwines (eprState (PauliRegister P))
+      (eprState_norm _) (swapUnitary w .alice) (v.swap_left_unitary .alice)
+      ((S.pauliMeas .alice W).effect h))
+    S.toStrategy.ψ (idealState P v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.aux)
+  have hlift (M : Op S.toStrategy.ιA) :
+      liftedAEffect S.toStrategy (ιB' := v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.ιB')
+          v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.φA M =
+        heteroKron (conjIsometry v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.φA M)
+          (1 : Op (v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.ιB' × PauliRegister P)) := by
+    ext i j
+    simp [liftedAEffect, heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker, Matrix.one_apply]
+  have hstate := v.state_close_ofExtractionWitness
+  rw [norm_sub_rev] at hstate
+  have hfull := full_pauli_distance_alice v W
+  have hbound := h.trans ((add_le_add
+    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfull (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2))
+    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hstate (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2))).trans_eq
+      (show 2 * delta + 2 * delta = 4 * delta by ring))
+  apply le_of_eq_of_le ?_ hbound
+  unfold pauliOperatorDistanceA
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro a _
+  exact congrArg (fun O => ‖applyOperatorToState (O - pauliProjOnA'' P W a)
+    (idealState P v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.aux)‖ ^ 2) (hlift _)
+
+/-- Bob's isometry-conjugated Pauli family satisfies the same bound on the
+same ideal state, without identifying the two original local spaces. -/
+theorem ExtractionWitness.pauli_distance_bob_le (v : ExtractionWitness S w delta)
+    (W : PauliKind) :
+    pauliOperatorDistanceB P S.toStrategy v.toPauliSoundnessWitness W ≤ 4 * delta := by
+  have h := sum_norm_rightTensor_conjIsometry_sub_sq_le
+    v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.φA v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.φB
+    (S.pauliMeas .bob W).effect (S.swappedPauliMeas w .bob W)
+    (pauliProjOnB'' P W)
+    (fun h => unitaryAncillaIsometry_intertwines (eprState (PauliRegister P))
+      (eprState_norm _) (swapUnitary w .bob) (v.swap_left_unitary .bob)
+      ((S.pauliMeas .bob W).effect h))
+    S.toStrategy.ψ (idealState P v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.aux)
+  have hlift (M : Op S.toStrategy.ιB) :
+      liftedBEffect S.toStrategy (ιA' := v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.ιA')
+          v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.φB M =
+        heteroKron (1 : Op (v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.ιA' × PauliRegister P))
+          (conjIsometry v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.φB M) := by
+    ext i j
+    simp [liftedBEffect, heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker, Matrix.one_apply]
+  have hstate := v.state_close_ofExtractionWitness
+  rw [norm_sub_rev] at hstate
+  have hfull := full_pauli_distance_bob v W
+  have hbound := h.trans ((add_le_add
+    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfull (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2))
+    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hstate (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2))).trans_eq
+      (show 2 * delta + 2 * delta = 4 * delta by ring))
+  apply le_of_eq_of_le ?_ hbound
+  unfold pauliOperatorDistanceB
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro a _
+  exact congrArg (fun O => ‖applyOperatorToState (O - pauliProjOnB'' P W a)
+    (idealState P v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.aux)‖ ^ 2) (hlift _)
+
+/-- Isometry transfer bounds for supplied extraction data in a projective
+setting. The common bound is `max (sqrt delta) (4 * delta)`: the state norm
+is unsquared and both operator distances sum squared norms over all outcomes.
+This is blueprint `ex:pauli-supplied-extraction-support`, a conditional
+support theorem for `thm:pauli`, not the source theorem.
+Discharging the supplied-data premise requires the global-pair construction
+and extraction; see `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_extraction-transfer.tex`, issue #529. -/
+theorem ExtractionWitness.isometry_transfer_bounds (v : ExtractionWitness S w delta) :
+    ∃ t : PauliSoundnessWitness P S.toStrategy,
+      ‖isometryTensor t.φA t.φB S.toStrategy.ψ - idealState P t.aux‖ ≤
+        max (Real.sqrt delta) (4 * delta) ∧
+      (∀ W : PauliKind, pauliOperatorDistanceA P S.toStrategy t W ≤
+        max (Real.sqrt delta) (4 * delta)) ∧
+      (∀ W : PauliKind, pauliOperatorDistanceB P S.toStrategy t W ≤
+        max (Real.sqrt delta) (4 * delta)) := by
+  refine ⟨v.toPauliSoundnessWitness, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
+  · exact (Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le v.state_close_ofExtractionWitness).trans (le_max_left _ _)
+  · intro W
+    exact (v.pauli_distance_alice_le W).trans (le_max_right _ _)
+  · intro W
+    exact (v.pauli_distance_bob_le W).trans (le_max_right _ _)
+
+/-- The actual transformed state lies in both local isometry ranges. These
+identities impose no range condition on the ideal comparison state. -/
+theorem ExtractionWitness.transformed_state_in_ranges (v : ExtractionWitness S w delta) :
+    applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (conjIsometry v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.φA 1) 1)
+        (isometryTensor v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.φA v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.φB
+          S.toStrategy.ψ) =
+      isometryTensor v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.φA v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.φB
+        S.toStrategy.ψ ∧
+    applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.φB 1))
+        (isometryTensor v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.φA v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.φB
+          S.toStrategy.ψ) =
+      isometryTensor v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.φA v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.φB
+        S.toStrategy.ψ := by
+  constructor
+  · rw [applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_conjIsometry, heteroKron_one_one,
+      applyOperatorToState_one]
+  · rw [applyOperatorToState_rightTensor_conjIsometry, heteroKron_one_one,
+      applyOperatorToState_one]
+
+private theorem four_mul_deltaQld_le {a b epsilon : ℝ}
+    (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hepsilon : 0 ≤ epsilon) :
+    4 * deltaQld a b epsilon P.m P.d P.q ≤ deltaQld (4 * a) b epsilon P.m P.d P.q := by
+  have hmd : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
+    Nat.one_le_cast.mpr (Nat.mul_pos P.one_le_m P.hd)
+  have hpow := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hmd (show a ≤ 4 * a by linarith)
+  unfold deltaQld
+  calc
+    4 * (a * Real.rpow ((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ) a *
+        (Real.rpow epsilon b + Real.rpow (P.q : ℝ) (-b) +
+          Real.rpow 2 (-(b * ((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ))))) =
+      (4 * a) * Real.rpow ((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ) a *
+        (Real.rpow epsilon b + Real.rpow (P.q : ℝ) (-b) +
+          Real.rpow 2 (-(b * ((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ)))) := by ring
+    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
+      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow (by linarith))
+      (add_nonneg (add_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hepsilon _)
+        (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _)) (Real.rpow_nonneg (by norm_num) _))
+
+/-- All three conditional soundness bounds have the source error form after
+enlarging the universal prefactor and halving the extraction exponent. This
+theorem assumes the actual extraction data in a projective setting; it does
+not construct the global-pair witness or assert unrestricted soundness.
+It supports blueprint `ex:pauli-supplied-extraction-error-support` and the
+constant adjustment at paper
+`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1868-1876`. The remaining source
+obligations are documented in `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_extraction-transfer.tex`. -/
+theorem pauli_soundness_deltaQld_ofExtractionWitness
+    (C a b : ℝ) (hC : 1 ≤ C) (ha : 1 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hb1 : b < 1) :
+    ∃ a' b' : ℝ, 1 ≤ a' ∧ 0 < b' ∧ b' < 1 ∧
+      ∀ (P : AdmissibleParams) (epsilon : ℝ), 0 ≤ epsilon → epsilon ≤ 1 →
+        ∀ (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon)
+          (w : GlobalPairWitness S (deltaQld a b epsilon P.m P.d P.q))
+          (_v : ExtractionWitness S w
+            (deltaExtract C (deltaConstructPaulis C epsilon
+              (deltaQld a b epsilon P.m P.d P.q) P.m P.d P.q) P.m P.d P.q)),
+          ∃ t : PauliSoundnessWitness P S.toStrategy,
+            ‖isometryTensor t.φA t.φB S.toStrategy.ψ - idealState P t.aux‖ ≤
+              deltaQld a' b' epsilon P.m P.d P.q ∧
+            (∀ W : PauliKind, pauliOperatorDistanceA P S.toStrategy t W ≤
+              deltaQld a' b' epsilon P.m P.d P.q) ∧
+            (∀ W : PauliKind, pauliOperatorDistanceB P S.toStrategy t W ≤
+              deltaQld a' b' epsilon P.m P.d P.q) := by
+  obtain ⟨A, B, hA, hB, hB1, herror⟩ := deltaExtract_le_deltaQld C a b hC ha hb hb1
+  refine ⟨4 * A, B / 2, by linarith, by positivity, by linarith, ?_⟩
+  intro P epsilon hepsilon hepsilon1 S w v
+  obtain ⟨t, ht, htA, htB⟩ := v.isometry_transfer_bounds
+  have hmono := deltaQld_mono (P := P) hA (le_refl A) (show B / 2 ≤ B by linarith)
+    (show 0 < B / 2 by positivity) hepsilon hepsilon1
+  have hfour := four_mul_deltaQld_le (P := P) (b := B / 2) hA hepsilon
+  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ deltaQld A (B / 2) epsilon P.m P.d P.q := by
+    have hA0 := zero_le_one.trans hA
+    simp only [deltaQld, Real.rpow_eq_pow]
+    positivity
+  have hcommon : max (Real.sqrt _) (4 * _) ≤
+      deltaQld (4 * A) (B / 2) epsilon P.m P.d P.q := max_le
+    (((Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (herror P epsilon hepsilon hepsilon1)).trans
+      (sqrt_deltaQld_le hA hepsilon)).trans
+        ((show deltaQld A (B / 2) epsilon P.m P.d P.q ≤
+          4 * deltaQld A (B / 2) epsilon P.m P.d P.q by linarith).trans hfour))
+    ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
+      ((herror P epsilon hepsilon hepsilon1).trans hmono)
+      (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4)).trans hfour)
+  exact ⟨t, ht.trans hcommon, fun W => (htA W).trans hcommon,
+    fun W => (htB W).trans hcommon⟩
+
+end
+
+end MIPStarRE.QPBT

+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Extraction.SourceUnitary
+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Test.Soundness.OperatorTransfer
+
+/-!
+# Pauli isometry bounds for projective settings
+
+The global polynomial-pair measurement and the extraction unitaries are
+constructed before transferring the three soundness estimates to local
+isometries. The result is restricted to projective settings and errors in
+`[0, 1]`; it does not assert soundness for arbitrary strategies.
+
+## References
+
+Blueprint `thm:pauli-projective-setting-isometry-support`; paper
+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1862-1876`
+and `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1426-1447`.
+The remaining domain and game-correspondence obligations are recorded in
+`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_extraction-transfer.tex` (issue #602).
+-/
+
+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
+
+noncomputable section
+
+/-- **Scope restriction:** For projective Pauli-test settings with
+`0 ≤ epsilon ≤ 1`, local isometries and a normalized auxiliary state satisfy
+the state norm and both complete Pauli-family bounds at a common `deltaQld`
+scale. The universal constants are fixed before the setting. The global-pair
+and extraction witnesses are constructed internally, not assumed.
+
+This is a formalization-only support result for blueprint `thm:pauli`, not
+the unrestricted theorem of the paper at
+`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1426-1447`.
+The isometry step follows the appendix at
+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1862-1876`;
+see `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_extraction-transfer.tex` (issue #602). -/
+theorem exists_projective_setting_isometry_bounds :
+    ∃ a b : ℝ, 1 ≤ a ∧ 0 < b ∧ b < 1 ∧
+      ∀ (P : AdmissibleParams) (epsilon : ℝ),
+        0 ≤ epsilon → epsilon ≤ 1 → ∀ S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon,
+          ∃ t : PauliSoundnessWitness P S.toStrategy,
+            ‖isometryTensor t.φA t.φB S.toStrategy.ψ - idealState P t.aux‖ ≤
+              deltaQld a b epsilon P.m P.d P.q ∧
+            (∀ W : PauliKind, pauliOperatorDistanceA P S.toStrategy t W ≤
+              deltaQld a b epsilon P.m P.d P.q) ∧
+            (∀ W : PauliKind, pauliOperatorDistanceB P S.toStrategy t W ≤
+              deltaQld a b epsilon P.m P.d P.q) := by
+  obtain ⟨a, b, C, ha, hb, hb1, hC, hextract⟩ := exists_extractionWitness
+  obtain ⟨A, B, hA, hB, hB1, htransfer⟩ :=
+    pauli_soundness_deltaQld_ofExtractionWitness C a b hC ha hb hb1
+  refine ⟨A, B, hA, hB, hB1, ?_⟩
+  intro P epsilon hepsilon0 hepsilon1 S
+  obtain ⟨w, ⟨v⟩⟩ := hextract P epsilon hepsilon0 hepsilon1 S
+  exact htransfer P epsilon hepsilon0 hepsilon1 S w v

+end

+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Test.Soundness.Ancilla
+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Combining.RootErrorBounds
+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Extraction.Unitary
+
+/-!
+# State transfer from supplied extraction data
+
+The extraction witness uses six registers, while the test conclusion groups
+each player's first two registers into the auxiliary space. Adjoining the local
+EPR states and applying the supplied swap unitaries gives the test isometries.
+The squared state error is unchanged by this identification.
+
+## References
+
+Formalization support for blueprint `thm:pauli` and
+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1864-1875`.
+This module transports supplied data without invoking either existence theorem.
+The companion `OperatorTransfer` module completes both operator comparisons.
+The source-facing obligations are tracked by issues #529 and #586 and
+`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_extraction-transfer.tex`.
+-/
+
+open scoped BigOperators Matrix
+
+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
+
+open MIPStarRE.Quantum MagicSquareRigidity
+
+noncomputable section
+
+variable {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG delta : ℝ}
+  {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon} {w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG}
+
+/-- The local isometries and auxiliary state associated to supplied extraction
+data. This is the construction in the final proof of `thm:pauli`, with the
+extraction conclusion explicitly given. No existence assertion is made. -/
+def ExtractionWitness.toPauliSoundnessWitness (v : ExtractionWitness S w delta) :
+    PauliSoundnessWitness P S.toStrategy where
+  ιA' := S.toStrategy.ιA × PauliRegister P
+  ιB' := S.toStrategy.ιB × PauliRegister P
+  φA := unitaryAncillaIsometry (eprState (PauliRegister P)) (eprState_norm _)
+    (swapUnitary w .alice) (v.swap_left_unitary .alice)
+  φB := unitaryAncillaIsometry (eprState (PauliRegister P)) (eprState_norm _)
+    (swapUnitary w .bob) (v.swap_left_unitary .bob)
+  aux := v.aux
+  aux_norm := v.aux_norm
+
+open Classical in
+/-- The two ancilla embeddings produce exactly the expanded strategy state,
+after grouping the local registers as `(AA')A''` and `(BB')B''`. -/
+theorem isometryTensor_ancilla_eq_psiHat (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon) :
+    isometryTensor
+        (ancillaBlockIsometry (ι := S.toStrategy.ιA)
+          (eprState (PauliRegister P)) (eprState_norm _))
+        (ancillaBlockIsometry (ι := S.toStrategy.ιB)
+          (eprState (PauliRegister P)) (eprState_norm _)) S.toStrategy.ψ =
+      reindexState (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) S.psiHat := by
+  ext p
+  simp [isometryTensor_apply_eq, ancillaBlockIsometry_matrix_apply, Matrix.kronecker,
+    Fintype.sum_prod_type, ProjectiveSetting.psiHat, reindexState, vecTensor,
+    sixRegExtractionEquiv, sixRegShuffle, mul_comm, mul_left_comm]
+
+open Classical in
+/-- The tensor of the constructed test isometries is the supplied simultaneous
+swap action, in test register order. This identity precedes every state-error
+estimate and requires no success or consistency bound. -/
+theorem ExtractionWitness.isometryTensor_eq (v : ExtractionWitness S w delta) :
+    isometryTensor v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.φA v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.φB
+        S.toStrategy.ψ =
+      reindexState (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
+        (S.applyBoth (swapUnitary w .alice) (swapUnitary w .bob) S.psiHat) := by
+  have haction := isometryTensor_ancilla_eq_psiHat S
+  change isometryTensor
+    (unitaryAncillaIsometry (eprState (PauliRegister P)) (eprState_norm _)
+      (swapUnitary w .alice) (v.swap_left_unitary .alice))
+    (unitaryAncillaIsometry (eprState (PauliRegister P)) (eprState_norm _)
+      (swapUnitary w .bob) (v.swap_left_unitary .bob)) S.toStrategy.ψ = _
+  rw [isometryTensor_eq_toEuclideanLin]
+  have hA := unitaryAncillaIsometry_matrix (eprState (PauliRegister P))
+    (eprState_norm _) (swapUnitary w .alice) (v.swap_left_unitary .alice)
+  have hB := unitaryAncillaIsometry_matrix (eprState (PauliRegister P))
+    (eprState_norm _) (swapUnitary w .bob) (v.swap_left_unitary .bob)
+  rw [hA, hB]
+  rw [Matrix.kronecker, Matrix.mul_kronecker_mul, toEuclideanLin_mul_apply]
+  rw [isometryTensor_eq_toEuclideanLin] at haction
+  erw [haction]
+  ext p
+  symm
+  change ((Matrix.kronecker (swapUnitary w .alice) (swapUnitary w .bob)).submatrix
+      (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
+      (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) *ᵥ
+        (fun i => S.psiHat i))
+      ((sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB).symm p) = _
+  erw [Matrix.submatrix_mulVec_equiv]
+  rfl
+
+open Classical in
+/-- The auxiliary-state/EPR vector is unchanged by grouping each player's
+first two registers into that player's auxiliary space. -/
+theorem ExtractionWitness.idealState_eq (v : ExtractionWitness S w delta) :
+    idealState P v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.aux =
+      reindexState (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
+        (S.idealExpState v.aux) := by
+  ext p
+  rfl
+
+open Classical in
+/-- The supplied extraction state's squared error is exactly the squared state
+error of its test witness. Only the register order changes. -/
+theorem ExtractionWitness.state_error_eq (v : ExtractionWitness S w delta) :
+    ‖isometryTensor v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.φA v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.φB
+        S.toStrategy.ψ - idealState P v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.aux‖ ^ 2 =
+      ‖S.applyBoth (swapUnitary w .alice) (swapUnitary w .bob) S.psiHat -
+        S.idealExpState v.aux‖ ^ 2 := by
+  rw [v.isometryTensor_eq, v.idealState_eq]
+  dsimp +instances only [ExtractionWitness.toPauliSoundnessWitness, ProjectiveSetting.LocalSpace,
+    ProjectiveSetting.localSpaceFintype, ProjectiveSetting.localSpaceDecidableEq]
+  have hsub : ∀ x y : EuclideanSpace ℂ (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB),
+      reindexState (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) x -
+        reindexState (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) y =
+      reindexState (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) (x - y) := by
+    intros x y
+    rfl
+  rw [hsub, reindexState_norm_eq]
+
+/-- Conditional transfer of the state estimate from fully supplied extraction
+data. The paper-facing theorem must still construct that data; see issue #529. -/
+theorem ExtractionWitness.state_close_ofExtractionWitness (v : ExtractionWitness S w delta) :
+    ‖isometryTensor v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.φA v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.φB
+        S.toStrategy.ψ - idealState P v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.aux‖ ^ 2 ≤ delta := by
+  rw [v.state_error_eq]
+  exact v.state_close
+
+/-- The saved extraction error composition and square-root estimate give the
+source's unsquared state bound for supplied extraction data. This conditional
+support theorem concerns the state estimate. The companion `OperatorTransfer`
+module proves the common bound for the state and both operator families. -/
+theorem extraction_state_norm_le_deltaQld_ofExtractionWitness
+    (C a b : ℝ) (hC : 1 ≤ C) (ha : 1 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hb1 : b < 1) :
+    ∃ a' b' : ℝ, 1 ≤ a' ∧ 0 < b' ∧ b' < 1 ∧
+      ∀ (P : AdmissibleParams) (epsilon : ℝ), 0 ≤ epsilon → epsilon ≤ 1 →
+        ∀ (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon)
+          (w : GlobalPairWitness S (deltaQld a b epsilon P.m P.d P.q))
+          (v : ExtractionWitness S w
+            (deltaExtract C (deltaConstructPaulis C epsilon
+              (deltaQld a b epsilon P.m P.d P.q) P.m P.d P.q) P.m P.d P.q)),
+          ‖isometryTensor v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.φA v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.φB
+              S.toStrategy.ψ - idealState P v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.aux‖ ≤
+            deltaQld a' b' epsilon P.m P.d P.q := by
+  obtain ⟨a', b', ha', hb', hb1', hbound⟩ := deltaExtract_le_deltaQld C a b hC ha hb hb1
+  refine ⟨a', b' / 2, ha', by positivity, by linarith, ?_⟩
+  intro P epsilon hepsilon hepsilon1 S w v
+  exact (Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le v.state_close_ofExtractionWitness).trans
+    ((Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (hbound P epsilon hepsilon hepsilon1)).trans
+      (sqrt_deltaQld_le ha' hepsilon))
+
+end
+
+end MIPStarRE.QPBT

     1	\documentclass[11pt]{article}
     2	
     3	\usepackage{amsmath,amssymb}
     4	\usepackage{xurl}
     5	\usepackage[hidelinks]{hyperref}
     6	\setlength{\emergencystretch}{2em}
     7	
     8	\input{command}
     9	\renewcommand{\ghissue}[1]{%
    10	  \href{https://github.com/Dengnifer/MIPStarRE-A/issues/#1}{GitHub issue \##1}}
    11	
    12	\title{Triangle Estimates and Isometry Transfer in Pauli Extraction}
    13	\author{}
    14	\date{2026-09-15}
    15	
    16	\begin{document}
    17	\maketitle
    18	
    19	\section{At a glance}
    20	
    21	\begin{itemize}
    22	  \item \textbf{Difficulty.} Medium.  The extraction proof contains two
    23	  incorrect numerical steps and later suppresses the range projection when
    24	  passing from unitary conjugation to isometry conjugation.
    25	  \item \textbf{Estimated weight.} The corrected positive-contraction estimate,
    26	  small-error normalization split, and general range-projection transfer are
    27	  available; the concrete Pauli soundness application remains to be proved.
    28	  \item \textbf{Mathlib/project split.} Positivity, contraction inequalities,
    29	  isometry range projections, and norm estimates belong to finite-dimensional
    30	  Hilbert-space algebra.  The state-dependent family distance and register
    31	  placements are project-local.
    32	  \item \textbf{Key mathematical inputs.} The inequality
    33	  $H^2\geq2H-I$ for a positive contraction, the triangle inequality, and
    34	  $Q=\phi\phi^\dagger$ for an isometry.  The repair is tracked in
    35	  \ghissue{19}.
    36	\end{itemize}
    37	
    38	\section{Key theorem forms}
    39	
    40	Let $H_X$ and $H_Z$ be the positive contractions of the extraction proof, and
    41	let $\vartheta$ be a unit vector such that
    42	\[
    43	  \langle\vartheta,H_W\vartheta\rangle\geq1-\delta/2
    44	  \qquad (W\in\{X,Z\}).
    45	\]
    46	Since $(I-H_W)^2\geq0$,
    47	\[
    48	  H_W^2\geq2H_W-I,
    49	  \qquad
    50	  \langle\vartheta,H_W^2\vartheta\rangle\geq1-\delta.
    51	\]
    52	Also $\lVert(I-H_W)\vartheta\rVert^2\leq\delta$, whence
    53	\[
    54	  \lVert H_X\vartheta-H_Z\vartheta\rVert^2\leq4\delta.
    55	\]
    56	Together with $H_XH_Z$ equal to the EPR projection, these estimates give the
    57	required overlap bound, with constants absorbed into the stated
    58	$O(\sqrt\delta)$ error.
    59	
    60	For the final transfer, let $\phi\colon\mathcal H\to\mathcal K$ be an isometry
    61	and set $Q=\phi\phi^\dagger$.  If $N_h$ is the unitary-conjugated extension of
    62	a measurement operator $M_h$, then the exact identity is
    63	\[
    64	  \phi M_h\phi^\dagger=N_hQ=QN_h,
    65	\]
    66	not merely $N_h$.  Thus comparison of $N_h$ with an ideal projector must be
    67	combined with control of $(I-Q)\Delta$ on the ideal comparison state
    68	$\Delta$.
    69	
    70	\section{Numerical defects in the source proof}
    71	
    72	Lines~1715--1742 of
    73	\path{references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex}
    74	construct $H_X,H_Z$ and identify $H_XH_Z$ with the EPR projection.  The norm
    75	estimate at lines~1743--1750 gives
    76	$\lVert(I-H_W)\vartheta\rVert\leq\sqrt\delta$.  At lines~1753--1757 the
    77	source substitutes $\delta$ inside the reverse triangle inequality
    78	\cite[lines~1715--1783]{Ji2020MIPStar}.  That replacement is not valid for
    79	small $\delta$.  The desired lower bound on
    80	$\langle H_W^2\rangle$ follows directly from $H_W^2\geq2H_W-I$, as above.
    81	
    82	The triangle inequality yields
    83	\[
    84	  \lVert H_X\vartheta-H_Z\vartheta\rVert\leq2\sqrt\delta,
    85	\]
    86	so its square is at most $4\delta$.  Line~1761 instead bounds that square by
    87	$2\sqrt\delta$ without a stated restriction.  This inequality follows when
    88	$\delta\leq1/4$; for larger error the theorem is made trivial by enlarging the
    89	universal constant.  The same small-error split ensures that the projected
    90	vector defined at lines~1769--1773 is nonzero before it is normalized.  These
    91	are local numerical repairs and do not weaken the extraction conclusion.
    92	
    93	\section{The range-projection obligation}
    94	
    95	Lines~1827--1858 prove state-dependent closeness for the concrete operators
    96	obtained by conjugating the original measurement with the swap unitaries.
    97	Lines~1864--1875 then define isometries by adjoining EPR pairs and applying
    98	those unitaries, and immediately state the corresponding closeness for
    99	$\phi M_h\phi^\dagger$.  The omitted range projection makes this implication
   100	non-definitional \cite[lines~1827--1875]{Ji2020MIPStar}.
   101	
   102	Let $\Psi$ be the original state and suppose $\phi\Psi$ is close to the ideal
   103	state $\Delta$.  Since $Q\phi\Psi=\phi\Psi$ and $Q$ is a contraction, the
   104	triangle inequality bounds $(I-Q)\Delta$ by the state-extraction error.  Using
   105	$\phi M_h\phi^\dagger=N_hQ$, split
   106	\[
   107	  (N_hQ-T_h)\Delta
   108	  =(N_h-T_h)\Delta-N_h(I-Q)\Delta,
   109	\]
   110	where $T_h$ is the ideal Pauli projector.  Summing squared norms over $h$
   111	uses projectivity and orthogonality to keep the second term under control.
   112	The same argument is required for each player and each Pauli basis.
   113	
   114	The finite-dimensional estimate is proved in
   115	\path{MIPStarRE/QPBT/Test/Soundness/RangeProjection.lean}. For a complete POVM
   116	$\{N_h\}$, an orthogonal projection $Q$, and $Q\vartheta=\vartheta$, it gives
   117	\[
   118	  \sum_h\|(N_hQ-T_h)\Delta\|^2
   119	  \le 2\sum_h\|(N_h-T_h)\Delta\|^2+2\|\Delta-\vartheta\|^2.
   120	\]
   121	The proof uses $\sum_h N_h^\dagger N_h\le I$, so it also applies when the
   122	measurement is not projective. The same module proves the isometry form under
   123	the exact identity $N_h\phi=\phi M_h$ and its two bipartite placements. The
   124	unit-ancilla embedding and its composition with a unitary, including the
   125	identity $U(M\ot I\ot I)U^\dagger\phi=\phi M$, are proved in
   126	\path{MIPStarRE/QPBT/Test/Soundness/Ancilla.lean} for $\phi=UJ$,
   127	$J\psi=\psi\ot\eta$, $\|\eta\|=1$, and $U^\dagger U=I$.
   128	
   129	Applying these general results to the concrete swap unitaries, the
   130	transformed-state estimate, and the Pauli operator comparisons remains open.
   131	This step must not be stored as a bridge field, residual assumption, or
   132	hypothesis of the source-labelled soundness theorem.
   133	
   134	\section{Blueprint and formalization status}
   135	
   136	The proof of Lemma~\path{lem:qld-unitary} and the soundness proof in
   137	\path{blueprint/src/chapter/ch16_qpbt_extraction.tex} use the corrected
   138	positive-contraction estimate, make the small-error case distinction explicit,
   139	and isolate the range-projection calculation.  The chapter therefore preserves
   140	the source's state and observable conclusions while exposing the omitted
   141	argument.
   142	
   143	The structure \path{ExtractionWitness} in
   144	\path{MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean} contains only the two-sided
   145	unitarity equations for the concrete swap maps, a normalized auxiliary state,
   146	the transformed-state estimate, and the two-player Pauli-projector comparison.
   147	The theorem \path{exists_extractionWitness_ofGlobalPairWitness} concludes the
   148	existence of this data at the explicit extraction scale, but it takes the
   149	\path{GlobalPairWitness} of Lemma~\path{lem:qld-4-7} as an explicit hypothesis.
   150	It therefore remains a conditional helper rather than a formalization of the
   151	source lemma.  The blueprint records it on the separate formalization-support
   152	node \path{lem:qld-unitary-given-global-pair}, whose statement displays the
   153	global polynomial-pair measurement as supplied data.  The helper is proved at
   154	this conditional statement and has only the standard axioms \path{propext},
   155	\path{Classical.choice}, and \path{Quot.sound}.  Apart from the supplied witness,
   156	its conclusion matches the Stage~4.2 extraction lemma, including the corrected
   157	numerical estimates.
   158	
   159	The preceding global-measurement construction is now complete.
   160	The theorem \path{exists_globalPairWitness} proves the full-domain construction
   161	of Lemma~\path{lem:qld-4-7} for every strategy error, including zero.  The
   162	source-facing theorem \path{exists_pulled_apart_consistency} chooses one such
   163	witness, applies the two point-consistency estimates and the observable
   164	self-consistency estimate to it, and replaces their three universal constants
   165	by their maximum.  Thus Lemma~\path{lem:qld-construct-the-paulis} is proved for
   166	the stated domain $0\leq\epsilon\leq1$, including the zero-error boundary.
   167	
   168	The source-facing theorem \path{exists_extractionWitness} now composes
   169	\path{exists_globalPairWitness} with
   170	\path{exists_extractionWitness_ofGlobalPairWitness}: the universal error
   171	constants for the global measurement and extraction are chosen before the
   172	parameters and strategy. For every admissible parameter tuple and projective
   173	strategy with $0\leq\epsilon\leq1$, it constructs the global pair of
   174	projective measurements internally and obtains a normalized auxiliary state
   175	and two concrete swap unitaries satisfying the state and both players'
   176	Pauli-family distances at the nested construction/extraction scale. This is
   177	the existence claim of Lemma~\path{lem:qld-unitary}; its proof does not
   178	require a supplied global measurement. The general range-projection and
   179	unit-ancilla lemmas above prove the transfer under their stated POVM,
   180	intertwining, and state-closeness hypotheses. Their instantiation with the
   181	concrete swap operators and Pauli measurements, and the final isometry
   182	comparison for the source soundness theorem, remain open.
   183	
   184	The stronger theorem \path{exists_extractionWitness_fourth_root_rate}
   185	normalizes the numerical rate of this concrete conclusion to the same
   186	global-measurement parameter. Starting with the global error
   187	$\delta_G^{a_0,b_0}$, the scalar absorption theorem bounds the nested
   188	extraction error by another family member $\delta_G^{a_1,b_1}$. Choose
   189	$a\geq\max\{a_0,a_1+1\}$ and $b=\min\{b_0,b_1\}$. Monotonicity permits the
   190	\emph{same} global measurements to carry the larger consistency certificate
   191	$x=\delta_G^{a,b}$. If $x\leq1$, their established extraction error is at
   192	most $x\leq x^{1/4}$; if $x>1$, the universal four-error construction gives
   193	both estimates. Enlarging the extraction constant to at least four yields
   194	$C(x^{1/4}+md/q)$ in both cases. This normalization concerns the concrete
   195	swap maps only: it neither identifies the seed-indexed low-degree game with
   196	the direct carrier nor supplies the subsequent isometry range-projection
   197	transfer. It does not complete the unrestricted Pauli-test soundness claim.
   198	
   199	Issue~\#19 owns this concrete Stage~4.2 interface and discrepancy record.
   200	\ghissue{123} records the source-facing composition work: both the pulled-apart
   201	consistency and the source-unitary existence compositions are proved. Other
   202	issue~\#123 targets remain unfinished; the earlier attempt history is unchanged.
   203	The direct-carrier proof of the global constructor does not discharge the
   204	seed-indexed correspondence and direct-law restrictions documented in
   205	\path{docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex}.
   206	\ghissue{47} tracks the separate range-projection transfer needed
   207	by \path{pauli_soundness}; that theorem must be derived from the concrete data
   208	rather than stored in the witness.
   209	\ghissue{529} records the independent general range-projection and ancilla
   210	results; it does not discharge the concrete soundness transfer.
   211	
   212	\section{Conclusion}
   213	
   214	The printed triangle calculation has repairable numerical errors, and the
   215	last passage from unitaries to isometries omits a genuine range-projection
   216	argument.  Neither defect is a counterexample to Pauli soundness.  The former
   217	is corrected by positive-contraction inequalities and a small-error split;
   218	the latter has a proved general estimate but still requires an application to
   219	the concrete extraction data. The global polynomial-pair witness
   220	and the three pulled-apart consistency estimates are now composed in a proved
   221	source-facing theorem, including at zero error. The conditional extraction
   222	theorem remains useful for a supplied global measurement, and its composition
   223	with the proved global constructor establishes the source-facing existence
   224	claim of Lemma~\path{lem:qld-unitary} for projective strategies. The generic
   225	range-projection and ancilla transfer is proved, but its concrete application
   226	and the source-domain and final soundness obligations remain open.

    27	noncomputable def stateDistSq {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]

    41	  avgOver μ (fun x =>

    52	  swap_right_unitary : ∀ side : PlayerSide,
    53	    swapUnitary w side * (swapUnitary w side)ᴴ = 1

     5	
     6	The complete swap-conjugated measurements intertwine with the local ancilla

    30	private theorem extracted_alice_eq (W : PauliKind) (h : PauliRegister P) :
    31	    S.placeExtractedRegister .alice (pauliProj W h) =
    32	      reindexOp (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
    33	        (pauliProjOnA'' P (ιA' := S.toStrategy.ιA × PauliRegister P)
    34	          (ιB' := S.toStrategy.ιB × PauliRegister P) W h) := by
    35	  ext i j
    36	  change (1 : Op S.toStrategy.ιA) i.1.1 j.1.1 *
    37	    (1 : Op (PauliRegister P)) i.1.2.1 j.1.2.1 *
    38	    ((1 : Op S.toStrategy.ιB) i.2.1 j.2.1 * pauliProj W h i.1.2.2 j.1.2.2) *
    39	    (1 : Op (PauliRegister P)) i.2.2.1 j.2.2.1 *
    40	    (1 : Op (PauliRegister P)) i.2.2.2 j.2.2.2 = _
    41	  simp [reindexOp, sixRegExtractionEquiv, pauliProjOnA'',
    42	    Matrix.one_apply, Prod.ext_iff, ite_and, mul_ite, ite_mul]
    43	  split_ifs <;> simp_all

    46	    S.placeExtractedRegister .bob (pauliProj W h) =
    47	      reindexOp (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
    48	        (pauliProjOnB'' P (ιA' := S.toStrategy.ιA × PauliRegister P)
    49	          (ιB' := S.toStrategy.ιB × PauliRegister P) W h) := by
    50	  ext i j
    51	  change ((1 : Op S.toStrategy.ιA) i.1.1 j.1.1 * pauliProj W h i.2.2.2 j.2.2.2) *
    52	    (1 : Op (PauliRegister P)) i.1.2.1 j.1.2.1 *
    53	    (1 : Op (PauliRegister P)) i.1.2.2 j.1.2.2 *
    54	    (1 : Op S.toStrategy.ιB) i.2.1 j.2.1 *
    55	    (1 : Op (PauliRegister P)) i.2.2.1 j.2.2.1 = _
    56	  simp [reindexOp, sixRegExtractionEquiv, pauliProjOnB'',
    57	    Matrix.one_apply, Prod.ext_iff, ite_and, mul_ite, ite_mul]

    60	private theorem conjugated_alice_eq (_v : ExtractionWitness S w delta)

    63	        (S.placePlayer .alice ((S.pauliMeas .alice W).effect h)) =
    64	      reindexOp (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)

    66	  exact (S.placeSide_swappedPauliMeas w .alice W h).symm

    76	private theorem full_pauli_distance_alice (v : ExtractionWitness S w delta)
    77	    (W : PauliKind) :
    78	    ∑ h : PauliRegister P, ‖applyOperatorToState
    79	      (heteroKron ((S.swappedPauliMeas w .alice W).effect h) 1 -
    80	        pauliProjOnA'' P W h) (idealState P v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.aux)‖ ^ 2 ≤ delta := by
    81	  classical

    85	    ← WinImplications.reindexOp_sub,
    86	    ← WinImplications.norm_applyOperatorToState_reindexState] at hc
    87	  rw [v.idealState_eq]
    88	  exact hc

    91	    (W : PauliKind) :

    93	      (heteroKron 1 ((S.swappedPauliMeas w .bob W).effect h) -
    94	        pauliProjOnB'' P W h) (idealState P v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.aux)‖ ^ 2 ≤ delta := by
    95	  classical
    96	  have hc := v.pauli_close .bob W
    97	  rw [opFamilyDistSq_uniform_unit] at hc
    98	  simp_rw [conjugated_bob_eq v, extracted_bob_eq,
    99	    ← WinImplications.reindexOp_sub,

   101	  rw [v.idealState_eq]

   104	/-- Alice's isometry-conjugated Pauli family has squared distance at most
   105	`4 * delta` on the ideal state. Both the full-unitary comparison and the
   106	squared state error are read from the supplied extraction witness. -/
   107	theorem ExtractionWitness.pauli_distance_alice_le (v : ExtractionWitness S w delta)
   108	    (W : PauliKind) :
   109	    pauliOperatorDistanceA P S.toStrategy v.toPauliSoundnessWitness W ≤ 4 * delta := by
   110	  have h := sum_norm_leftTensor_conjIsometry_sub_sq_le
   111	    v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.φA v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.φB
   112	    (S.pauliMeas .alice W).effect (S.swappedPauliMeas w .alice W)
   113	    (pauliProjOnA'' P W)
   114	    (fun h => unitaryAncillaIsometry_intertwines (eprState (PauliRegister P))
   115	      (eprState_norm _) (swapUnitary w .alice) (v.swap_left_unitary .alice)
   116	      ((S.pauliMeas .alice W).effect h))
   117	    S.toStrategy.ψ (idealState P v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.aux)
   118	  have hlift (M : Op S.toStrategy.ιA) :
   119	      liftedAEffect S.toStrategy (ιB' := v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.ιB')
   120	          v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.φA M =
   121	        heteroKron (conjIsometry v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.φA M)
   122	          (1 : Op (v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.ιB' × PauliRegister P)) := by
   123	    ext i j
   124	    simp [liftedAEffect, heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker, Matrix.one_apply]
   125	  have hstate := v.state_close_ofExtractionWitness
   126	  rw [norm_sub_rev] at hstate
   127	  have hfull := full_pauli_distance_alice v W
   128	  have hbound := h.trans ((add_le_add
   129	    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfull (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2))
   130	    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hstate (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2))).trans_eq
   131	      (show 2 * delta + 2 * delta = 4 * delta by ring))
   132	  apply le_of_eq_of_le ?_ hbound
   133	  unfold pauliOperatorDistanceA
   134	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   135	  intro a _
   136	  exact congrArg (fun O => ‖applyOperatorToState (O - pauliProjOnA'' P W a)
   137	    (idealState P v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.aux)‖ ^ 2) (hlift _)
   138	
   139	/-- Bob's isometry-conjugated Pauli family satisfies the same bound on the
   140	same ideal state, without identifying the two original local spaces. -/
   141	theorem ExtractionWitness.pauli_distance_bob_le (v : ExtractionWitness S w delta)
   142	    (W : PauliKind) :
   143	    pauliOperatorDistanceB P S.toStrategy v.toPauliSoundnessWitness W ≤ 4 * delta := by
   144	  have h := sum_norm_rightTensor_conjIsometry_sub_sq_le
   145	    v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.φA v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.φB
   146	    (S.pauliMeas .bob W).effect (S.swappedPauliMeas w .bob W)
   147	    (pauliProjOnB'' P W)
   148	    (fun h => unitaryAncillaIsometry_intertwines (eprState (PauliRegister P))
   149	      (eprState_norm _) (swapUnitary w .bob) (v.swap_left_unitary .bob)
   150	      ((S.pauliMeas .bob W).effect h))
   151	    S.toStrategy.ψ (idealState P v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.aux)
   152	  have hlift (M : Op S.toStrategy.ιB) :
   153	      liftedBEffect S.toStrategy (ιA' := v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.ιA')
   154	          v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.φB M =
   155	        heteroKron (1 : Op (v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.ιA' × PauliRegister P))
   156	          (conjIsometry v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.φB M) := by
   157	    ext i j
   158	    simp [liftedBEffect, heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker, Matrix.one_apply]
   159	  have hstate := v.state_close_ofExtractionWitness
   160	  rw [norm_sub_rev] at hstate
   161	  have hfull := full_pauli_distance_bob v W
   162	  have hbound := h.trans ((add_le_add
   163	    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfull (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2))
   164	    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hstate (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2))).trans_eq
   165	      (show 2 * delta + 2 * delta = 4 * delta by ring))
   166	  apply le_of_eq_of_le ?_ hbound
   167	  unfold pauliOperatorDistanceB
   168	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   169	  intro a _
   170	  exact congrArg (fun O => ‖applyOperatorToState (O - pauliProjOnB'' P W a)
   171	    (idealState P v.toPauliSoundnessWitness.aux)‖ ^ 2) (hlift _)

   173	/-- Isometry transfer bounds for supplied extraction data in a projective
   174	setting. The common bound is `max (sqrt delta) (4 * delta)`: the state norm
   175	is unsquared and both operator distances sum squared norms over all outcomes.
   176	This is blueprint `ex:pauli-supplied-extraction-support`, a conditional
   177	support theorem for `thm:pauli`, not the source theorem.
   178	Discharging the supplied-data premise requires the global-pair construction
   179	and extraction; see `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_extraction-transfer.tex`, issue #529. -/
   180	theorem ExtractionWitness.isometry_transfer_bounds (v : ExtractionWitness S w delta) :
   180	theorem ExtractionWitness.isometry_transfer_bounds (v : ExtractionWitness S w delta) :
   181	    ∃ t : PauliSoundnessWitness P S.toStrategy,
   182	      ‖isometryTensor t.φA t.φB S.toStrategy.ψ - idealState P t.aux‖ ≤

   184	      (∀ W : PauliKind, pauliOperatorDistanceA P S.toStrategy t W ≤
   185	        max (Real.sqrt delta) (4 * delta)) ∧
   186	      (∀ W : PauliKind, pauliOperatorDistanceB P S.toStrategy t W ≤

   190	  · intro W
   191	    exact (v.pauli_distance_alice_le W).trans (le_max_right _ _)
   192	  · intro W
   193	    exact (v.pauli_distance_bob_le W).trans (le_max_right _ _)
